entities.summary: Roldani Baldwin is a Dominican professional baseball catcher for the Long Island Ducks of the Atlantic League of Professional Baseball. He signed with the Boston Red Sox as an international free agent in 2013 and played for their organization until 2022. He won the bronze medal with the Dominican Republic national baseball team in the 2020 Summer Olympics.
